abstract: Marathon running has grown quickly in Thailand, but existing websites only list events with brief information and links, show routes as static map images, and keep no record of runners once an event ends. This project built a web based management system where runners can register, view event information and routes, join events, see ranks, and find photos tagged to them. Administrators can create and manage events, build event routes with Google My Maps, enter finish times that automatically generate ranks, and tag runners in event photos. The website was developed with WordPress and the EventOn event calendar plugin, customized with PHP and database modifications. Test cases for user registration, login, event registration, and runner management all passed.

Apartment managers in Thailand still keep tenant information, contracts, and utility records on paper, which can be lost or damaged and leads to calculation mistakes. This project develops a web based apartment management system that runs on the apartment local area network for the manager and staff. The system records rooms, tenants, and contracts, calculates electricity and water bills, tracks payments and expenses, checks room availability, and prints ready to sign contracts and invoices. It also generates monthly utility and summary reports for the manager. The system is written in PHP with a MySQL database, uses Bootstrap for the interface template, runs on AppServ with the Apache web server, and generates PDF files with FPDF.

abstract: Buyers face many smartphone models with different features and it is difficult to pick one that fits their preferences and budget. Phonies is a proposed website where users can browse smartphone specifications, compare models side by side, and get a product recommendation. The matching system pairs smartphones with the lifestyle favorites stored in a member profile or entered directly, filtered by the desired budget, and also ranks products by popularity based on member clicks. Administrators can add, update, and delete products with correct specifications and reliable images. The system is planned as an online web application written in PHP with a MySQL database administered through phpMyAdmin and hosted on Z.com hosting.

canonical_title: Piano Score Sheet with Pitch Alphabets Generator using Optical Music Recognition
abstract: For beginners who learn to play piano, recognizing the pitch alphabet of each music note and their position has always been handy stuff. That's the main problem that we're going to solve in this senior project I. In order to solve that problem, we are going to build a platform that end users can upload their sheets and then we will apply Haar-like feature to adopt to Optical Music Recognition process to print the pitch alphabet on top of each music note that is going to help the users be able to read the sheet music easily. For our senior project I, our system will be able to detect both PDF and digital image format of sheet music and convert them into some digital format printed upon each music note.

In our childhood, we grew up playing computer games. Computer game is the most common source of entertainment because it makes the player feel involved since they can interact with the game to achieve some goals of the game. Unlike watching movies or listening to music, with games players get the change of interacting and bring out their emotions while playing like killing, fighting, competing and many more. So, the concept of this project comes up with the games that remind us of our childhood. Therefore, we try to design a 2D game into 8 bit resolution like the old ones that we are familiar with. The story of the game is based on university life combine with some Sci-Fi theme.

To make our game fun and challenging we have different stages with different level of difficulty. The first stage is rather simple and easy so novice players can begin to play and get used to how to play. Once they move to next level it gets harder and more killing, jumping, being aware of the fire is required. We show the score on the screen to make it more interesting and keep count of the score by increasing the number of the score as the player kills a monster and collect the scores until the player dies or reaches the end of level.

We hope our game can make people enjoy playing and find the challenges interesting and want to play more.
